channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: Morgan Stanley is cutting 3% of its workforce in core business lines, including banking, trading, and wealth
item.description: The cut, which was earlier reported by the Wall Street Journal, is expected to hit about 2,500 jobs. Business Insider has details on who's affected.

item.title: I've raised my 3 kids across Switzerland, Australia, and the US — each culture has taught me valuable parenting lessons
item.description: After raising my children across different countries (the US, Australia, and Switzerland), I've kept the best parenting strategies and tips that work

item.title: My city was filling up with digital nomads, so I converted my family home into a business
item.description: Hana Nguyen convinced her parents to let her convert their family home in Vietnam into a coworking space for digital nomads visiting Da Nang.

item.title: Judge clears path for refunds on Trump's tariffs that the Supreme Court ruled unlawful
item.description: A federal judge on Wednesday said companies are entitled to benefits from the recent Supreme Court ruling that struck down Trump-era tariffs.

item.title: US releases names of 6 service members killed in the Iran conflict
item.description: The fallen service members, who were killed in a drone strike, were serving in the Army Reserve under the 103rd Sustainment Command, Des Moines, Iowa.

item.title: Jensen Huang says a $100 billion investment in OpenAI is 'probably not in the cards'
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said a $100 billion investment in OpenAI is unlikely as the AI startup prepares for a potential IPO.

item.title: The State Department says it's boosting flights across the Middle East to get Americans home. Here's what to know.
item.description: The State Department said charter flights to bring back US citizens will be made available across the Middle East.

item.title: The oil price spike won't fix Russia's strained finances, an analyst says
item.description: Rising oil prices usually boost Russia's budget. But sanctions, discounts, and a strong ruble are limiting the benefit.

item.title: The US is urging Americans to leave the Middle East immediately. What to know if you're there.
item.description: After Israel and the US struck Iran, triggering retaliation on the weekend, the Trump administration said on Tuesday that it would help Americans return from the Middle East.

item.title: Multiple US embassies told Americans they could not evacuate or help them get out of the Middle East
item.description: US embassies in Jerusalem and Qatar issued statements on Tuesday saying they could not help Americans leave the Middle East.
